Transaction in Own Shares AI Summary Close X Bellway repurchased 129,205 ordinary shares between 9 and 13 November 2026 (daily purchases: 26,000; 26,000; 25,814; 26,000; 25,391) through Citigroup on XLON at an aggregated VWAP of 2,301.92p, with prices paid ranging from 2,246.00p to 2,370.00p per share; the purchased shares will be cancelled, bringing cumulative Buyback Programme cancellations to 1,437,225 shares since 1 September 2026 and reducing total ordinary shares in issue to 111,024,776. Disclaimer* Bellway PLC 16 November 2026 Bellway p.l.c. Transaction in Own Shares 16 November 2026 Bellway p.l.c. ('Bellway' or the 'Group') announces that, in accordance with the terms of the share buyback programme (the 'Buyback Programme') announced on 1 September 2026, from 9 November 2026 up to and including 13 November 2026 the Group purchased the following number of ordinary shares of 12.5 pence each (the ‘Ordinary Shares') through Citigroup Global Markets Limited.
